QuestInfo.0: Because you've become a resident of a new world, #e#b#p9010010##k#n would like to speak with you. Find her in any major town.
QuestInfo.1: #e#b#p9010000##k#n is passing out free mesos to those who've settled in this new world. This settlement fund should help you get your bearings.

0.0: I read on a website that helping others will increase my karma, which'll bring me all sorts of good things. So, to welcome you to this new world of #b#eTempest#k#n, I'd like to give you a settlement fund of #e#r500,000 Mesos#k#n! Am I not generous?! You want it, like, right now?

no.0: I've never heard of anyone turning down free money, but whatevs. Do what you want.

yes.0: I hope this settlement helps you...and brings me a TON of good karma. That last part's the most important.
